audit.yml.reason: the weekly Secret Scan failed its last six weekly runs (2026-09-14 to 2026-10-19); the latest on one false positive: generic-api-key on a 16-character hex placeholder assigned to KEY, line 4 of voter-app/src/api/staticPolity.test.ts at commit 133f2b10, which only the unmerged branch feat/static-polity holds and the scan reads (`git log --all`). Fixed by its fingerprint in .gitleaksignore; the scheduled scan checks out polity, so the fix needs no develop sync, and its first green run is Monday 2026-10-26 06:00 UTC, which this date covers. The previous snooze (until 2026-10-21) expired before a scheduled run could clear it.

mutation-testing.yml.reason: the frontend job failed from 2026-10-12 because vitest.stryker.config.ts used mergeConfig, which concatenated the base include with the two playgroundVoting files, so Stryker's dry run executed ~180 test files from its .stryker-tmp sandbox and methodCriteria.test.ts failed reading docs/research/bibliography.bib (ENOENT). Fixed in this PR (include is now overridden; the dry run passes locally, 158 tests). Mutation Testing runs on push to develop/polity, on a Monday schedule and on workflow_dispatch, never on a PR, so the first green run comes after this merges; the snooze covers that window and must not be renewed again: if the run is still red by this date the fix did not work.
